top_signals.title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 10% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
top_signals.summary: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged more than 10% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fund Redemption Woes Trigger Circuit Breaker in Turkish Stocks
top_signals.summary: Turkish stocks tumbled on Wednesday and triggered a market-wide circuit breaker, as an asset manager’s failure to meet redemption requests fueled concern about broader liquidity stress in the country’s investment fund industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Underdog sues Connecticut to stop sports prediction market crackdown
top_signals.summary: The lawsuit follows cease-and-desist orders the state issued to prediction market platforms, including Underdog, Polymarket, and Coinbase.
